successors.name: Lan Xang
successors.text: Muang Sua (Luang Prabang) and its valley on the Mekong and Nam Khan; the page gives no frontier

capitals.name: Muang Sua (Xieng Dong Xieng Thong, Luang Prabang)

ledger.x: c. 800: Nanzhao's hold ends. The infobox reads 'Nanzhao vassal: 709-800s' and the page says the occupation 'probably ended well before the northward expansion of the Khmer Empire under Indravarman I (reigned 877-889)'; 800 is the infobox's start of its range, not a date the page gives.
1128: Muang Sua becomes the Sri Sattanak Kingdom; Khun Chueang reigns 1128-1169.
1353: Fa Ngum takes Muang Sua and founds Lan Xang.

wars.name: Lao-Mongol invasion of Dai Viet (1297-1301)
wars.outcome: 'From 1297 to 1301, Lao troops under Mongol command invaded Dai Viet but were repulsed by the Vietnamese'; no change of border.

certainty.note: Chronicle history with Khmer, Nanzhao, Mongol and Sukhothai overlordships; no frontier is given.
